title: Extrapolation of solvability of the parabolic $L^p$ Neumann problem on bounded Lipschitz cylinders
summary: A recent result of the first author with Li and Pipher has established the extrapolation of solvability of the $L^p$ parabolic Neumann problem on unbounded graph domains of the form $Ω=\{(x',x_n):\,x_n>\varphi(x')\}\times\mathbb R$, where $\varphi:\mathbb R^{n-1}\to\mathbb R$ is a Lipschitz function. The result shows that under the assumptions that the $L^p$ parabolic Neumann problem for the equation $Lu=-\partial_t u+\mbox{div}(A\nabla u)=0$ in $Ω$ and also the $L^{p'}$ parabolic Dirichlet problem for the adjoint equation $L^*u=\partial_t u+\mbox{div}(A\nabla u)=0$ in $Ω$ are solvable, then…
